location_reference: loc-farmhouse-01 (original: weathered farmhouse kitchen with a window onto a dusk field; front door at screen right of kitchen)
floor_plan: Kitchen interior. Window on the far wall looks onto a flat field and a treeline. Front door on screen right. Table center. Dale works at screen left near the window; June at screen right near the door; Rosa at the table center.

light.direction: warm lantern key from the table centre; cool dusk fill from the window
light.color: warm amber lantern against blue-grey dusk
light.source: kerosene lantern on the table; fading daylight through the window

time_of_day: dusk into night, final shot at dawn
ambience: wind over the field, creaking timber, distant low moaning carried on the wind; no music

axis_180.description: Camera stays on the kitchen side of the Dale–June line. Dale is always screen left looking right; June is always screen right looking left. Rosa is centre or off-screen.

prop_inventory.name: old double-barrel shotgun, held only, never fired on screen
